prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Atlanta after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can recommend several Atlanta personal-injury firms you should call and explain why each is worth speaking with. If you want, I can next pull phone numbers/addresses and give a short script and list of documents to bring to consultations.

Top firms to call (why each):

1) Morgan & Morgan (Atlanta)
- Why: One of the largest plaintiff personal-injury firms in the U.S.; lots of resources for investigation, medical experts, and handling insurance companies. Good if you want a big team and broad experience with car-accident claims.
- Best if: you want strong intake support, fast access to resources, and a contingency-fee arrangement.

2) Pope McGlamry (Pope McGlamry, Kilpatrick & Morrison)
- Why: Atlanta-based plaintiff firm with an established personal-injury practice and a reputation for taking cases to trial when necessary. Good track record on serious injury claims.
- Best if: you need a local firm with trial experience and personal attention to large or complex cases.

3) The Cochran Firm Atlanta
- Why: Nationally known personal-injury practice (founded by Johnnie Cochran) that handles motor-vehicle accidents and serious injury cases; experienced litigators and local presence.
- Best if: you want a firm with name recognition and experience dealing with contested liability or high-value claims.

4) Slappey & Sadd
- Why: Longstanding Atlanta personal-injury firm focused on car accidents and wrongful death. Known locally for hands-on client service and experience with Georgia courts and insurers.
- Best if: you prefer an Atlanta-rooted firm that emphasizes client communication and Georgia-specific experience.

5) Harris Lowry Manton LLP
- Why: Georgia-based plaintiffs’ personal-injury firm that handles auto collisions and catastrophic injury cases; known for focused plaintiff representation and litigation experience.
- Best if: you want a firm with regional focus and experience negotiating major settlements and trying cases when needed.

How to choose which to prioritize calling
- Severity of injury: For catastrophic injuries, prioritize firms with trial experience (Pope McGlamry, Cochran, Harris Lowry).
- Desire for hands-on/local counsel: prioritize Atlanta-based firms (Pope McGlamry, Slappey & Sadd, Harris Lowry).
- Want lots of resources/fast intake: Morgan & Morgan.
- Concerned about cost: all of these typically work on contingency (no fee unless they recover).

What to do next (I can help)
- If you want, tell me your ZIP or neighborhood and I’ll find phone numbers, office hours, and recent client ratings for these firms and any others nearby.
- I can also give a short “phone script” and the key questions to ask during a free consultation (statute of limitations, fees, likely case value, whether they’ll handle medical liens, trial vs settlement approach).

Do you want me to look up contact details and prepare a one-page call script and document checklist for these firms? Also, tell me a few quick facts about your accident (date, injuries, whether police report/insurance info exists) so I can tailor the advice.
